TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CARDNUMBER,EMBOSSNAME,ACCOUNTID,CARDTYPE,CARDSUBTYPE,CARDSTATUS,EXPIRYDATE,CUSTOMFIELD1,CUSTOMFIELD2,CUSTOMFIELD3,CUSTOMFIELD4,CUSTOMFIELD5,BANK_ID,CIFID))
	 AS HASHROW,
	CIFID
	,BANK_ID,CARDNUMBER
FROM (	SELECT
[CARDNUMBER]
,[EMBOSSNAME]
,[ACCOUNTID]
,[CARDTYPE]
,[CARDSUBTYPE]
,[CARDSTATUS]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EXPIRYDATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as EXPIRYDATE
,[CUSTOMFIELD1]
,[CUSTOMFIELD2]
,[CUSTOMFIELD3]
,[CUSTOMFIELD4]
,[CUSTOMFIELD5]
,[BANK_ID]
,[CIFID]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [d360].[STG_CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS]
 where H = 'D' 
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CARDNUMBER,EMBOSSNAME,ACCOUNTID,CARDTYPE,CARDSUBTYPE,CARDSTATUS,EXPIRYDATE,CUSTOMFIELD1,CUSTOMFIELD2,CUSTOMFIELD3,CUSTOMFIELD4,CUSTOMFIELD5,BANK_ID,CIFID))
	AS HASHROW,
	CIFID
	,BANK_ID,CARDNUMBER
FROM	BUSC.CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS
WHERE	isLatest = 1  
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.CRM_CBSCUSTCARDDETAILS_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,CIFID,BANK_ID,CARDNUMBER,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CIFID,TGT.CIFID) AS CIFID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CARDNUMBER,TGT.CARDNUMBER) AS CARDNUMBER
	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.CIFID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.CIFID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN SRC.CIFID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.CIFID IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	    WHEN SRC.HASHROW != TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.CIFID = TGT.CIFID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND SRC.CARDNUMBER = TGT.CARDNUMBER 
	
WHERE	(
	SRC.CIFID IS NULL
OR	SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	SRC.CARDNUMBER IS NULL
OR	TGT.CIFID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.CARDNUMBER IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
